resources.string: What Sparta does on this phone, what it keeps, and what it asks for.
Saved on this phone. Connect a backend to sync it.
These rules apply on this phone, even with no connection. A screened call is silenced and you are told: Sparta does not answer calls on this phone.
The ringer is silenced and you get a notification.
The ringer is silenced with no notification.
No screening for unknown numbers. Hidden numbers are still screened in strict mode.
Calls whose caller ID fails verification are treated as unknown.
Calls whose caller ID fails verification are silenced.
Calls whose caller ID fails verification are rejected, and hidden numbers are always screened.
No backend is connected, so these settings are only stored on this phone.
Numbers are stored on this phone only as a keyed fingerprint and a masked display. Entries from your backend are removed through the backend.
Android allows Sparta to show notifications.
Alert when a caller looks legitimate and Sparta wants your decision.
A quiet note when Sparta silences or blocks a call on this phone.
Also alert when Sparta ends a call as high risk.
Include short quotes of what the caller said when you open the notification. Turn off to keep their words out of notifications entirely. The lock screen only ever shows a generic title.
Notifications arrive without sound or vibration during this window.
Connect a backend to set high-risk alerts, notification content and quiet hours.

Alerts about a live call arrive instantly only while Sparta is open. When it is closed they come from a periodic check that runs about every 30 minutes, so they can be late. Instant push alerts are not set up.
Sparta has no call recording at all, and it never stores raw call audio.
When off, the backend keeps the summary and the risk result but not the words.
Encrypted on the backend. This phone never sends a full number: it sends only a masked display and a keyed fingerprint.
Every call, transcript and summary is removed from your backend and from this phone. Block and trust lists stay. This cannot be undone.
Screening decisions recorded on this phone are removed. Copies already uploaded to the backend stay there.
History on this phone was deleted.
Refreshes your block lists and checks for calls that need you about every 30 minutes, only with a network and a battery that is not low. No foreground service and no wake lock.
Sparta forgets the address and stops syncing. Screening keeps working on this phone with the lists and rules it already has.
When Sparta talks to a caller it never gives out, and never accepts requests to reveal, any of the following. A caller asking for them is treated as a warning sign.
Connect a backend to see the full list of protected information.
Sparta asks for as little as it can, and only after explaining.
Lets Android ask Sparta about each incoming call so it can let it ring, silence it or reject it. You choose it in a system dialog and can withdraw it in Android settings.
To tell you when a call needs you or when Sparta silenced or blocked a caller.
Only to ask Android whether a number is one of your contacts. Names and numbers are not read, copied or uploaded.
To talk to your Sparta backend.
Sparta never asks for the microphone, the phone state, the call log or storage, and it never records calls.
